result.instructions: Trammel plans multi-file changes in dependency order and keeps plans, constraints, failures and recipes in .trammel/ so later sessions and other agents can pick work up. Loop: get_constraints and get_recipe, start_plan, then per step verify_step (tests run on a temporary copy), then complete_plan. To hand off, add_note what you did and what is left; the next agent calls get_plan with the plan_id and reads the notes. TRAMMEL_MCP_SURFACE=all adds claim_step, available_steps and record_steps for several agents on one plan.

relevant_only.description: Order steps by goal relevance instead of dependency order.

scope.description: Subdirectory to analyze, relative to project_root.

strict_greenfield.description: Reject create-only goals that name no file paths.

summary_only.description: Return file list and counts, not full steps.
